Home.resourceDescription: Access a wide range of materials designed to inform, support, and empower. Whether you're looking for training guides, policy documents, toolkits, or educational content
Home.searchPlaceholder: Search for resources, guidelines, training materials...
Home.communityMessage: Everyone has a place here whether you are a person with disability, a family member, a professional, or simply someone who cares about inclusion. Connect, share ideas, and be part of a vibrant community driving positive change and support for all.
Home.enterEmail: Enter your email address to join with our community
Home.privacyAgreement: By entering your mail, you are agreeing to our privacy policy
Home.thankYouOrganizations: Thank you to all the organizations that contributed resources and shared knowledge to support disability inclusion in humanitarian and development programs.
Home.hubFundingInfo: This hub is developed with funding from the Commonwealth of Australia represented by the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) and is supported by Humanity & Inclusion and the Age and Disability Technical Working Group (ADTWG) under the ISCG.

Footer.inclusiveFutureMessage: Working together to build an inclusive, accessible, and empowered future for persons with disabilities...

ResourceLibrary.disabilityResources: Access our comprehensive collection of disability inclusion resources, including guidelines, training materials, research reports, and tools.
ResourceLibrary.featuredResourcesDesc: Explore a curated selection of high-impact tools, guides, and publications designed to advance disability inclusion in humanitarian action.
ResourceLibrary.accessibleResourcesDesc: Our resources are designed to be accessible to all users, including persons with disabilities—featuring formats that support screen readers, alternative text.
ResourceLibrary.resourceFormatsInfo: Resources are available in multiple formats (PDF, Word, Video, Audio) to accommodate different accessibility needs.
ResourceLibrary.screenReaderDocsInfo: All documents are optimized for screen readers, with proper headings, alternative text, and document structure.
ResourceLibrary.multilingualResourcesInfo: Many resources are available in both English and Bangla to ensure accessibility for local and international users.
